title: Man Steals TWO Cop Cars During Insane High Speed Chase

transcript.text: Someone stole a Coco PD car with the gun in the back and everything. Cocoa County police officers had responded to a report of a disturbance near a motel. When they confronted the agitated suspect, they were taken by surprise when he managed to jump into an unattended police patrol car and peeled off.
